name: Altered Consciousness
body:
School transmutation; Level alchemist 1

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components S

EFFECT

Range personal
Target you
Duration 1 min./level

DESCRIPTION

Imbibing this extract elevates your consciousness to a higher realm, allowing you to perceive the flow of time differently. As a result, you can anticipate the actions of others, granting bonuses to your armor class. You gain a +1 dodge bonus to your AC plus an additional +1 per 4 levels after 1st (maximum bonus of +5 at 17th level).
